description: This file defines an API service module that uses axios to perform HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE) with standardized error handling and token-based authentication. It exports an 'api' object with methods for making requests to a backend server, and includes an internal function for extracting error details from failed requests.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the specified path with data, normalizing the response and handling errors.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified path with query parameters, normalizing the response and handling errors.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Performs a PUT request to the specified path with data, normalizing the response and handling errors.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Performs a DELETE request to the specified path, normalizing the response and handling errors.

methods.name: extractError
methods.description: Extracts and formats error information from failed HTTP requests.
